controls.toggleHud: Mist HUD: open / close the hero HUD

hud.invertTag: This roll only: make this tag hinder (or help again)
hud.invertWeakness: This roll only: this weakness helps instead of hindering
hud.roteHint: Click: use this rote's title as a tag. Double-click: open the rote.
hud.createTagHint: Type a name. "name-2" creates a status; "/sn name-2" a hindering one.
hud.statusHint: Click: helps (+) → hinders (−) → not used. Double-click: edit. Right-click: delete. Drag onto a token.
hud.promisesHint: Click a box to set the number of Promises
hud.readyToImprove: Ready to Improve: three Improve marks on this theme

npcHud.overcome: Overcome: a Limit has been reached

rollMode.name: Rolling from the HUD
rollMode.hint: Roll at once with the HUD selection, or open the system's roll dialog prefilled (to add help, Might or check the Power). Shift-click a move button for the other option.

autoOpen.name: Open the HUD when selecting your hero's token
autoOpen.hint: Selecting one of your hero tokens opens its HUD.

npcHudOnTokenHud.name: Narrator: open the challenge HUD from the token HUD
npcHudOnTokenHud.hint: Right-clicking a Challenge token opens its HUD.

useTextButtons.name: Text move buttons
useTextButtons.hint: Show the action names instead of the illustrated buttons.

keyToggle.name: Open / close the hero HUD
keyToggle.hint: Opens the HUD of the selected token, or your character.

diceSet.name: Dice So Nice: dice for every d6
diceSet.hint: Which 3D dice every d6 is rolled with, the same for all players. "Each player's choice" keeps everyone's own Dice So Nice settings (both sets are listed there).
diceSet.classic: Classic Legend in the Mist die (d12 body, raven and Greatness)

notify.systemLoadFailed: Mist HUD (Legend in the Mist): could not load system file(s): {files}. The system may have changed; rolling from the HUD may not work.
notify.rollApiUnavailable: Mist HUD: the system's roll dialog is not available.
notify.noGM: Mist HUD: a Narrator must be connected to do this.
